description: CMHC describes absorbed newly built homes by price range, dwelling type and municipality. Coverage includes urban centres with at least 50,000 residents; four dwelling types are reported for 17 named metropolitan or agglomeration areas, with narrower single/semi-detached coverage for other metropolitan areas and Charlottetown. The source records a 2023-04 version. Its sole distribution name ends in XLSX while the format field says CSV; both statements are preserved and the actual encoding is unverified. This measures absorption of new residential stock, not all sales or an inventory of available dwellings. Exact observation dates and the definition of absorption are not provided in inspected metadata. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata.
